# UC-MUSE2 — Your agent, the Agent Privilege (external agent, lane 2)

**Track:** tools  
**Maturity:** ✅ `works`  


## Buyer Story

Teams running PingOne Privilege want the same external-agent story through the Agent Privilege: the user’s own agent, governed by per-user policy at the gateway rather than per-call token exchange.

## PingOne Solution

The agent connects to the facade’s privilege-gateway door: OAuth against the demo’s durable broker doubles as the sign-in that raises the BFF’s server-side leg to the Agent Privilege, which swaps the caller’s bearer for the operator’s token on the upstream hop (ownsUpstreamAuth) and enforces per-user policy.

> Same agent, other door: the facade registers the client durably, your sign-in raises the gateway leg server-side, and the Agent Privilege swaps credentials and enforces per-user policy on the way up.
